unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: P1 L1 still admits a natural alternative order after the per hari repair
evidence: The new canonical chips are [sedangkan] [yang dekat kantor] [menghemat waktu saya] [hampir dua jam] [per hari.].
Zero-based order [0,1,4,2,3], disregarding punctuation as required, gives: Yang di pinggir kota jelas lebih hemat, sedangkan yang dekat kantor per hari menghemat waktu saya hampir dua jam.
Per hari can precede the predicate as a rate/frequency adjunct and preserves the same commute-saving claim. Its period cannot be the sole reason to reject that otherwise natural order.
The structural native gate correctly checks only canonical reconstruction; it does not claim to prove permutation uniqueness. No alternate-order field or runtime acceptance was demonstrated.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.arbitration: Fable classified the prior finding FIX because per hari binds duration. This independent rereview does not consider that sufficient proof of unique order. The P2 L2 first-clause swap and P2 L6 time-fronting examples from the initial finding are eliminated by the new fixed prefixes; no claim of exhaustive permutation proof is made for those or the other builds.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredFix: Before publication, support and test the natural authored order above, or obtain a native-reviewed regrouping/visible target cue that makes the exercise uniquely answerable. Do not alter canonical audio merely to silence the structural gate.

lessonAssessment.episodeRead: Near/offices versus outskirts: recurring rent, commute cost and energy are weighed; annual-cost challenge and final choice differ.
Train versus car: late journeys receive a transport alternative; the child-pickup steer changes the recommendation.
Remote work: focus on reports, coordination objection, shared office days, and an evidence-based final argument.
Three-month rental: short-term cost, annual-extension objection, maintenance/resale comparison and rent-to-own request.
Holiday cost versus available days; a genuine fare promotion changes the proposed destination and timing.
Cash/app trade-off: transaction fee and connectivity objection; observed lost custom; both options retained.
App versus class: independent study and speaking practice; overtime objection; combined plan and conditional escalation.
Job offers: salary/security versus responsibility; specific start-up risk conceded; mortgage condition changes the choice.
Moving versus staying: salary versus net costs; supplied housing changes the plan to a rental-preserving trial year.
Parking proposals: street displacement weighed; monitoring responsibility distributed; time-bound notice summarized.
Invoice discrepancy: added chairs and separate shipping; included-delivery objection answered by shipment distinction.
Local bin rules: sorting, refusal of mixed bins and separate glass/battery collection remain explicitly scene-specific.
Delay: ten supplier days plus four staffing days account for two weeks; next-year mitigation follows.
Fictional reward ladder: presentation-before-payment condition and lost-card phone linkage resolve distinct questions.
Internet change: stability rather than price; modem counterexample answered with replacement evidence; coverage check follows.
Cooperative fine: local seven-day written process, honest leniency request, discretionary decision and reported instalment precedent.
Cancelled cafe: omitted utilities and exhausted capital; rushed contract reading conceded; future budgeting addresses the mistake.
Clinic flow: local routine queue rule is clarified for emergencies; the final two-part procedure preserves that distinction.
Campus bicycle report: source-qualified observed effects; active-term counting answers the holiday challenge; village effect stays hedged.
Market decision: May meeting, missed nonmembers and March-to-June sequence remain consistent after removing dari.

priorHoldsDisposition.evidence: P2 L5 focus 11, chips [2,4,1,2,2]; P2 L9 focus 12, chips [2,2,2,3,3]. All fit the unchanged 1–4 chip and 7–12 focus limits. Fable’s ≤3 handcount for P2 L5 was incorrect, but it does not breach the actual ≤4 rule.

Fable classified the prior finding FIX because per hari binds duration. This independent rereview does not consider that sufficient proof of unique order. The P2 L2 first-clause swap and P2 L6 time-fronting examples from the initial finding are eliminated by the new fixed prefixes; no claim of exhaustive permutation proof is made for those or the other builds.
Six exact specification edits reconcile the singleton rule; lexical menetap/mengajukan/Dampaknya are grouped; the P1 L9 coordinated noun phrase keeps dan attached.
Ten exact accepted-answer additions closed; two Jika begitu locations remain disputed as recorded.
The identified second-valid choices were replaced and the final recalled sentences and options personally reread. This is a contextual semantic assessment, not a general synonym algorithm.

The exact originally identified detail distractors were replaced with contrasting predicates/relations and reread in context; no hidden de/en gloss was treated as a learner-visible cue. Final rendering remains under PUB-08.
P2 L7 dialogue[1].base.en and pattern.examples[0].base.en now both say before we could open.
Native gate engineering PASS is now available; all other runtime/publication limits retained.
